args: Run 'python3 auto_issue_solver.py --find' to discover open-source 'good first issue' tasks on GitHub. Inspect the top candidate issue, clone/fork the target repository into 'repos', analyze the problem, implement the fix, run unit tests to verify, and submit a pull request using 'gh pr create'.
display_name: Open Source Issue Solver (Cloud Remote Agent)
description: Daily at 6:00 PM (Asia/Kolkata), automatically scans GitHub for open-source beginner issues, writes and verifies the fix, and opens a pull request directly in the cloud.
